info.name: GovtPrep Backend API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for testing GovtPrep backend API endpoints. Matches the current backend routes/controllers exactly (excludes the Exam Success Hub frontend). No pre-request or test scripts are included — responses shown are exactly what the backend returns, nothing injected by Postman.

Auth: set `token` (a student/instructor JWT from Login) and `admin_token` (an admin JWT) as collection variables — grab both from the Login response's `token` field for the respective account.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Forgot/reset password flow lives in the separate "GovtPrep — Forgot & Reset Password" collection.

item.name: 3. Categories

item.description: totalQuestions and totalMarks are auto-calculated from the test's active questions — no need to set them on create/update. Delete is a soft-delete (isActive/isPublished set to false).

item.name: 6. Questions
item.description: correctAnswer is a 0-based index into options (0=first option). Delete is a soft-delete (isActive set to false). Bulk upload expects a CSV with the columns from the template download (correctAnswer there is 1-based, converted server-side).

item.name: 7. Test Attempts (Core Testing Flow)
item.description: Save Answer and Submit Test take the attempt id in the JSON body (attemptId), not in the URL path.

item.name: 10. Media Upload
item.description: Accepted file types: image/*, video/*, application/pdf. Max 20MB. Delete is a hard delete (removes the DB record and the file on disk).

item.name: 11. Static Pages
item.description: Delete here is a hard delete (Page has no soft-delete flag).

item.name: 13. Notifications
item.description: type must be one of: info, reminder, result, offer, system. Omit userId (or leave it null) to broadcast to all users.

item.name: 14. Admin - Users
item.description: List Users has no pagination server-side (role/isActive filters only — every matching user is returned). Block/Unblock and Change Role hit the same PATCH endpoint — it accepts role, isActive, name, email, mobile in any combination.

item.name: 16. Admin - Reports
item.description: status must be one of: pending, reviewed, resolved.

item.name: 17. Settings
item.description: Settings is a singleton document — there is only ever one. socialLinks is a free-form object (Mixed type).
